source_title: Sol Names A+E Global Media's Dan Silberman Head of Marketing & Communications - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Veteran media executive joins the business and IT transformation firm as its Media & Entertainment practice scales
NEW YORK , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sol , the leading vendor-neutral firm for AI-enabled business and IT transformation, today announced the appointment of Dan Silberman as Head of Marketing & Communications. Silberman joins the firm after twenty years at A+E Global Media, where he most recently served as Executive Vice President of Communications. He reports to Sol Managing Partner Kaan Aslansan and will be based in New York.
Silberman will own Sol's brand, marketing and communications strategy end to end, covering positioning and narrative, earned media, content and thought leadership, digital presence, internal communications and reputation management, with the work tied to pipeline and growth. Sol takes enterprise clients from AI strategy to live implementation, including agentic AI systems, workflow modernization and workforce transformation, with a core focus in Media, Entertainment & AdTech, as well as state and local government and education (SLED).
He arrives during the firm's fastest period of expansion. Sol has built out a dedicated AI Acceleration practice under Steve Miller, formerly Chief Digital Officer at Xerox, with former Xerox CEO Steven Bandrowczak as senior advisor, taking clients from diagnosis to live agentic systems. Sol also recently launched its first industry-aligned practice, Media, Entertainment and AdTech, under newly appointed practice lead Ashley J. Swartz.
Silberman joins from A+E Global Media, where he led media relations, corporate and internal communications, crisis management, social strategy and talent relations for The HISTORY Channel, A&E Network, A+E Factual Studios and Oscar-winning feature division A&E IndieFilms, brands reaching more than 400 million households across 200 territories. Earlier, at NBCUniversal, he led press and publicity for Bravo Media, overseeing a full rebrand from its performing-arts roots, launching Queer Eye and Project Runway , and helping transform the network into a pop-culture phenomenon. He began his career at New York's preeminent public relations firm, Rubenstein Communications, and holds a Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Politics & Law from Binghamton University. He has been named to The Hollywood Reporter 's Next Gen list and Multichannel News ' 40 Under 40, received the CableFAX Award for PR Executive of the Year, and serves on the Board of Directors of LMC Media, the largest tri-state area community media center outside of New York City.
"We've built Sol on the strength of our delivery. Now we're investing in making sure the market knows it," said Kaan Aslansan, Managing Partner at Sol . "Dan has built and defended brands under genuine public scrutiny, at a scale most firms never touch. He's exactly what this next phase of growth needs, and he'll make sure the market sees what our clients already do."
"Twenty-five years in television taught me that attention follows the story you tell about your work, not just the work itself," said Silberman . "Sol is competing with firms several times its size and winning, which is the rare case where the story is sitting right there waiting to be told. I'm joining a team of doers that is reshaping how their clients operate, and I'm here to make sure it sounds like it. I've made a career of learning a new business from the best people in it. I want Sol to be the name people already know when we walk in the room."
About Sol Founded in 2020 and led by Managing Partners Kaan Aslansan, Daniel Gavula, and Carl Graves, Sol is a technology-agnostic business and IT transformation firm that utilizes AI to redesign how companies operate and deliver measurable results, from strategy and operating model design to adoption across the workforce. Its Sprint 0 discovery process pairs seasoned practitioners with SAGE, Sol's proprietary AI engine, to deliver implementation-ready plans in four to eight weeks rather than the three to six months traditional discovery takes. Sol delivers enterprise AI strategy, agentic AI implementation, workflow modernization, and workforce transformation for clients across industries and public-sector agencies, and measures itself on outcomes rather than recommendations. Learn more at www.wearesol.com .
